findings.evidence: The same direct `RingHom.map_det` application already appears in `GLn/Basic.lean:201` and `GLn/Basic.lean:242`.
findings.fix: Delete it and use `by simpa [RingHom.mapMatrix_apply] using (RingHom.map_det (Int.castRingHom ℚ) A).symm` at its three call sites.

findings.evidence: Mathlib defines `Matrix.map_mul` in `Mathlib/Data/Matrix/Mul.lean:439`; TauCeti already uses exactly `simp only [← Int.coe_castRingHom, ← Matrix.map_mul]` in `GLn/Basic.lean:273`.
findings.fix: Remove it and rewrite the two products with `← Matrix.map_mul`.
findings.issue: The local `h_map_mul` reproves matrix-map preservation of multiplication entrywise.

findings.evidence: `HeckeCoset.rep_mem` is defined in `HeckeRing/Basic.lean:84`, while `diagCoset_toSet` at line 144 identifies the required underlying set.
findings.fix: Replace the proof with `by simpa only [diagCoset_toSet] using HeckeCoset.rep_mem (diagCoset a)`.
findings.issue: `diagCoset_rep_mem` spends several lines reconstructing what `HeckeCoset.rep_mem` and `diagCoset_toSet` already state.

summary: Several proof helpers rederive existing matrix and Hecke-coset lemmas instead of using them directly.
